article.name: How do I get a physician order for testing?
article.title: How do I get a physician order for testing?
article.body: No additional action is required on your part. Labcorp OnDemand® has contracted with independent professional entities (collectively, Providers) to deliver independent healthcare provider services when you purchase testing. You will be contacted for any results that require follow-up with a healthcare provider.   However, you are also encouraged to speak with your primary healthcare provider about your results.  The price of each test includes the fee for the ordering provider’s services. For your convenience, Labcorp collects this fee on behalf of the ordering provider.
